description: This file defines interfaces and structures related to the IGstSrc component in the Rialto media server, including factory pattern, stream info, and setup methods for GStreamer app sources.

classes.name: IGstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving singleton instances of IGstSrc.

classes.name: IGstSrc
classes.description: Interface for managing GStreamer source elements, including initialization and setup of app sources.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Sets up and attaches an app source to a media source element with specified callbacks and user data.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Notifies that all app sources have been added to the source element.
